tasks.subject: Task 1: meta.py — language detection + rich metadata + unit tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A dependency-free, fail-open module that detects ISO 639-1 language and extracts rich metadata from raw HTML.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/growth_scraper/meta.py`
- Modify: `src/growth_scraper/config.py` (add `LANG_STOPWORDS`)
- Test: `tests/test_meta.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `detect_language(html, text)` returns `str | None`: html lang → content-language → stopwords (≥80 tokens, ratio ≥0.05, 1.5× margin)
- `extract_meta(html, url)` stable-shape dict, urljoin, all None when absent
- Never raises on empty/broken HTML
- `LANG_STOPWORDS` for es/en/pt/fr/de/it

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/test_meta.py -q` → 10 passed

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/growth_scraper/meta.py", "src/growth_scraper/config.py", "tests/test_meta.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_meta.py -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["detect_language heuristics", "extract_meta stable shape", "fail-open", "LANG_STOPWORDS"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: screenshot.py + pipeline integration + e2e tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pipeline populates `record.meta`, `summary.language`, `record.screenshots`; screenshots captured in `before_retrieve_html` hook, propagated only on success.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/growth_scraper/screenshot.py`
- Modify: `src/growth_scraper/pipeline.py`
- Modify: `tests/fixtureserver.py` (add `/meta-rich`)
- Test: `tests/test_meta.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `capture_screenshot` writes PNG, returns abs path, errors → None
- `Session.screenshot_path`; hook captures when `cfg.screenshot_dir` set
- `run_one`: record.meta, summary.language, record.screenshots on success
- `/meta-rich` fixture serves lang=es + OG/canonical/author/published_time/favicon
- Server mode unchanged

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/test_meta.py -q` → 13 passed; `uv run pytest tests/ -q` → all green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/growth_scraper/screenshot.py", "src/growth_scraper/pipeline.py", "tests/fixtureserver.py", "tests/test_meta.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_meta.py -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["screenshot capture", "hook wiring", "record.meta + language + screenshots", "e2e passes"]}
```
